questions.question: A can complete a work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 25 days. If both of them work together, then in 3 days what percent of the total work will be completed?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day 1/20thof the total work

work done by B in 1 day is 1/25thof the total work

⇒ Work done in 3 days = 3 × (1/25 + 1/20)

⇒ work done in 3 days = 27/100 of total work

Which is 27 × 100/100 percent

∴ 27% of the total work will be completed

questions.question: Two people A and B are at a distance of 260 km from each other at 9 : 00 a.m. A immediately starts moving towards B at a speed of 25 km/h and at 11 : 00 a.m. B starts moving towards A at a speed of 10 km/hr. At what time (in p.m.) will they meet each other?
questions.solution:
Distance travelled by A from 9 am to 11 am .i.e. 2 hrs is

⇒ Distance = 25 × 2

⇒ 50 Kms

Now, remaining distance = (260 – 50)

⇒ 210 Kms is remaining distance between them

Relative speed = 25 + 10

⇒ relative speed = 35 km/hr

time taken by them to cover 210 Kms is

⇒ 210/35

⇒ 6 hours

∴ they will meet at 6 hours from 11 am i.e. at 5 pm

questions.question: A, B and C are three students. A got 18% more marks than B and 12% less than C. If B got 220 marks, then how much marks C has got?
questions.solution:
Given that B got 220 marks

⇒ A got 18% more that of B’s marks

⇒ A’s marks = 220 × (1 + 18/100)

⇒ A’s marks = 220 × 1.18

⇒ A’s marks = 259.6

Given that A’s marks are 12% less than that of C

⇒ A’s marks = 12% less than that of C

⇒ C’s marks × (1 – 12/100) = 259.6

⇒ C’s marks = 259.6/0.88

∴ C’s marks are 295

questions.question: Smaller diagonal of a rhombus is equal to length of its sides. If length of each side is 6 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of an equilateral triangle whose side is equal to the bigger diagonal of the rhombus?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = AC = 6 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f555c395f6853a906aeb7de378c917966c96527d809387a4ed158e3771bbf1.png] 

Diagonals in the rhombus bisect each other at a right angle.

In ΔAOB

AO² + BO² = AB²

⇒ (6/2)² + BO2 = (6)2

⇒ 9 + BO2 = 36

⇒ BO2 = 27

⇒ BO = 3√ 3

So, Bigger diagonal = 2× 3√ 3 = 6√ 3

Hence, area of equilateral triangle

⇒√3/4 × side²

⇒ √3/4 × (6√3)2

⇒ 27√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: If x = 1 – y and x² = 2 – y², then what is the value of xy?
questions.solution:
Given,

x = 1 – y

⇒ x + y = 1 (Squaring both sides)

⇒ x² + y² + 2xy = 1 (Using x² = 2 – y²)

⇒ 2 – y² + y² + 2xy = 1

⇒ 2+ 2xy = 1

⇒ xy = -1/2

questions.question: The length of two parallel sides of a trapezium are A and 12 m. If its height is 8 m, the area (in m²) of the trapezium is 100 find the length of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two parallel sides are a and 12, height = 8 and area is 100.

**Formula used:**

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × sum of parallel sides × height

**Calculation:**

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × sum of parallel sides × height

⇒ 100 = 1/2 × (A + 12) × 8

⇒ 100 ÷ 4 = A + 12

⇒ 25 = A + 12

⇒ A = 13

**∴ The value of A is 13 cm.**

questions.question: If two successive discounts of 50% and 10% are offered, then what is the net discount?
questions.solution:
Let the initial price be Rs. 100

After 2 successive discounts

⇒ 100 × (1 – 50/100) × (1 – 10/100)

⇒ 100 × 0.5 × 0.9

⇒ Rs. 45

So, Rs. 100 object is to be sold at Rs. 45

⇒ overall discount is Rs. 55

∴ 55% effective discount is been offered

questions.question: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral and PQ is the diameter of the circle. If ∠RPQ = 38°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠PSR?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f05ff244bcc9a309c1af5ec62c93561a29d22cc146f3aaa68f929e07ffa10d20.png] 

Since it is given that ∠RPQ is 38°

⇒ Since PQ is diameter

⇒ ∠QRP must be 90° (Angle subtended by the diameter)

⇒ In triangle PRQ

⇒ ∠RPQ + ∠PQR + ∠QRP = 180° using the above values

⇒ ∠PQR = 180 – 90 – 38

⇒ ∠PQR = 52°

Since it is cyclic quadrilateral

⇒ ∠PQR + ∠PSR = 180

⇒ ∠PSR = 180 – 52

∴ ∠PSR is 128°

⇒ – 0.3 and the value of 3 √5 – 7 = 3 × 2.23 – 7 = – 0.3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

**Calculation:**

x + [1/(x + 7)] = 0

Adding both side 7

⇒ x + 7 + 1/(x + 7) = 7

Squaring both side

⇒ (x + 7)² + 1/(x + 7)² + 2 = 49

⇒ (x + 7)2 + 1/(x + 7)2 = 47

Subtracting both side by 2

⇒ (x + 7)2 + 1/(x + 7)2 - 2 = 47 - 2

⇒ {(x + 7) - 1/(x + 7)}² = 45

⇒ x + 7 - 1/(x + 7) = √45

⇒ x - 1/(x + 7) = √45 - 7

**∴ The value of x – [1/(x + 7)] is √45 - 7.**

questions.question: If (1/x) + (1/y) + (1/z) = 0 and x + y + z = 9, then what is the value of x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz?
questions.solution:
Given (1/x) + (1/y) + (1/z) = 0

⇒ (xy + yz + zx) /(xyz) = 0

⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0 ---- (1)

and x + y + z = 9, squaring both sides

⇒ (x + y + z)² = 81

⇒ x² + y² + z²+ 2xy + 2yz + 2zx = 81 Using (1)

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 81 ---- (2)

Since we know that x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = (x + y + z)( x² + y² + z² – xy – yz - zx)

Using (1) and (2) and x + y + z = 9

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = 81 × 9

∴ x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = 729

questions.question: The average age of 6 members of a family is 20 yeaRs. If the age of the servant is included, then the average age increase by 25%. What is the age (in years) of the servant?
questions.solution:
Average age after adding the age of servant will be = 20 × (1 + 25/100)

⇒ average age after adding servants age = 25 years

Let servants age be x, from the questions statement

⇒ sum of age of all family members except servant/6 = 20

⇒ sum of age of all family members except servant = 120….(i)

Now,

Given that (sum of age of all family members except servant + x)/7 = 25

⇒ sum of age of all family members except servant + x = 7 × 25

From (i) we get

⇒ x = 7 × 25 – 120

⇒ x = 55

∴ servant’s age is 55 years
